searchLog: Blocked before real hunting could start: this session's network egress proxy allows only anthropic.com/*.anthropic.com and blocks every other domain tested (Ashby/Greenhouse job-board APIs, company career pages like nvidia.com/ramp.com/databricks.com/metacareers.com/sierra.ai/openai.com, and even reference sites like en.wikipedia.org, nsf.gov, and ycombinator.com — 12 domains tried, only anthropic.com resolved). WebSearch itself still works and returned snippets, but per the hunt rules a snippet is never sufficient to include an opportunity — every candidate requires an actual page fetch to confirm applications are open and Dom is eligible, and that fetch is not possible this run. The one page I could reach (anthropic.com/careers/jobs) only surfaced 'Applied AI Architect, Commercial,' which is already in the last-40 sent-log (2026-08 hunt) and so is excluded as a duplicate regardless. Zero verified opportunities is the correct output given zero fetchable sources, not a quality judgment on the target-company list.
